# Alex Results-Loop

Local guide to the loop-analysis result subtree under the Alex snapshot's
`testdata/`.

## Role

`qcsp-alex-sep16-1997/testdata/Results-Loop/` preserves a specialized
loop-focused result family that sits beside the broader `Results/` tree.

This is archive/provenance material, not a supported active validation surface.

## Current Shape

The tree includes:

- loop-oriented preserved results,
- and a `before-dec-30/` historical layer.

## Relationship To Other Areas

- `testdata/Results/` is the broader preserved Alex results tree.
- `testdata/thesis-results/` is the publication-layout layer.
- `Q-Batch-SBCL/` is the supported modern experiment workspace.

## Rule Of Thumb

Use this directory when the question is specifically about preserved
loop-analysis results, not when you want the main current experiment path.
